note: unhingedthemes keeps ONLY the latest zip upstream, so the clean base of the version we ship is committed at base_zip_local (immune to upstream deleting older versions). upstream_zip_url is used by the watcher/adopt to fetch newer versions.
changelog: 2.2.11: re-merged onto clean Gears 2.4.0 (Simkl integration: auth, sync service, calendar, watched-indicator source #2; navigator menu props now cleared at service start so icon/name edits apply without a manual Restore Menu; resume-point handling moved into watched_status.apply_resume_to_listitem). TRAP: upstream converted the whole addon from CRLF to LF, so a naive 3-way merge reported 12 conflicts across ~8600 'changed' lines -- all phantom. Normalising ours/base/new to LF first dropped it to ZERO conflicts and a real surface of 8-150 lines per file; our overlay files are now LF too, so the next re-merge is clean. All 6 overlaid files verified: KODIRDIL markers intact (8/3/1/3/2/1), 10 hebrew_subtitles settings present, TorBox days-remaining banner intact, Simkl features fully adopted, 0 upstream lines lost (every apparent loss confirmed as our own baked default: max_threads 100, omdb key, cached-only external check, results.timeout 12, no auto-rescrape, autoscrape_next_episode). Also: upstream shipped _tmp_tango.py, a maintainer's personal sqlite debug script with hardcoded %APPDATA% paths -- excluded from the mirror and the shipped zip (the committed base zip keeps it, staying byte-identical to clean upstream for future merges). Hebrew subtitles overlay (kodirdil) + baked build defaults (cached-only fast search, non-blocking Hebrew match, meta_language he). 2.2.10: official TMDb network logos for the streaming-networks folder (11 icons).
